units.name: CO2 feed compressor
units.purpose: pressurise purchased dry CO2 feed to methanation loop pressure

units.name: H2 feed compressor
units.purpose: pressurise purchased dry H2 feed to methanation loop pressure

units.name: Recycle compressor
units.purpose: restore pressure of recycled unreacted gas after separation and purge

units.name: Feed mixer
units.purpose: mix fresh CO2, fresh H2 and recycle to the reactor feed ratio

units.name: Feed effluent heat exchanger
units.purpose: recover reactor effluent sensible heat to preheat mixed feed

units.name: Trim preheater
units.purpose: raise feed from heat-recovery outlet to reactor inlet temperature during start-up or low heat recovery

units.name: Cooled methanation reactor
units.purpose: convert CO2 and H2 to CH4 and water over the literature catalyst while removing exothermic heat

units.name: Effluent cooler and water knockout
units.purpose: cool reacted gas below the water dew point and remove liquid water

units.name: Methane purification membrane
units.purpose: recover pipeline-grade CH4-rich product from unreacted CO2/H2 and any CO byproduct

units.name: Product compressor
units.purpose: compress purified methane product to delivery pressure

units.name: Recycle purge splitter
units.purpose: split tail gas into a small purge that prevents inert/byproduct buildup and a recycle stream

units.name: Utilities and offsites
units.purpose: cooling water, instrument air, controls, flare, wastewater handling and site infrastructure

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: No separate regeneration unit is included because the screened CO2 methanation papers generally report stable fixed-bed operation or only short deactivation tests; catalyst loss is represented economically by replacement frequency instead.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  CO2[CO2 feed] --> C1[CO2 feed compressor]
  H2[H2 feed] --> C2[H2 feed compressor]
  REC[recycle gas] --> RC[Recycle compressor]
  C1 --> M[Feed mixer]
  C2 --> M
  RC --> M
  M --> HX[Feed-effluent heat exchanger]
  HX --> PH[Trim preheater]
  PH --> R[Cooled methanation reactor]
  R --> HX
  HX --> KO[Effluent cooler and water knockout]
  KO --> SEP[Methane purification membrane]
  KO --> W[Waste water]
  SEP --> PC[Product compressor]
  PC --> PROD[Methane product]
  SEP --> SPL[Recycle purge splitter]
  SPL --> REC
  SPL --> PURGE[Purge gas]
  W --> OS[Utilities and offsites]
  PURGE --> OS
  OS --> OUT[vent and wastewater]
